verdict.rationale: Docs show some control levers — selecting which repos get automatic reviews (graphite-docs-19), custom rules and comment exclusions to suppress bot comments in certain situations (graphite-docs-5, graphite-docs-20) — but there is no documented mechanism for skipping draft PRs, triggering a review on demand, or filtering by branch/label as the story specifies. Missing for 10: explicit draft-skip toggle, on-demand/manual trigger command, and branch/label-based filtering rules.
